from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/invoices/{invoice_id}")
async def read_invoice(invoice_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    invoice = await find_invoice(invoice_id, owner_id=user.id)
    if invoice is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="invoice not found")
    return invoice
